## Gamification & Achievement System

### Feature Overview
Increase user engagement through achievement badges, streaks, and challenges.

### Features to Implement

#### 1. Achievement Badges
- **Completion Badges**: Visit entire zones (10 badges)
- **Speed Badges**: Complete challenges quickly
- **Consistency Badges**: Visit pandals every day (streak tracking)
- **Explorer Badges**: Visit rare/remote pandals
- **Social Badges**: Share, invite friends, help community
- **Theme Badges**: Visit pandals of specific themes

#### 2. Streak System
- Consecutive days of visits
- Zone completion streaks
- Daily visit streaks
- Streak milestones (7 days, 14 days, etc.)
- Streak breaks & recovery options

#### 3. Difficulty Levels & Challenges
- **Easy**: Most popular pandals
- **Medium**: Moderate crowd zones
- **Hard**: Remote or obscure pandals
- **Expert**: Complete all in X hours
- **Community**: Group challenges

#### 4. Points & Leveling
- Points for each pandal visit
- Bonus points for first-time visitors
- Bonus for helping others (reviews, photos)
- Level progression system
- Milestone rewards

#### 5. Leaderboards & Rankings
- Personal best times
- Zone completion rankings
- All-time visitor counts
- Monthly seasonal rankings
- Friend rankings

### Technical Requirements
- Achievement tracking database
- Streak calculation engine
- Points/XP system
- Badge unlock logic
- Leaderboard ranking algorithm
- Notification system for achievements

### Achievement Categories
- **Completionist**: Visit all 120+ pandals
- **Speedrunner**: Complete zones in under X hours
- **Consistent**: 30-day visit streak
- **Community**: Upload 10+ photos or reviews
- **Social**: Invite 5+ friends
- **Explorer**: Visit all 12 zones
- **Photographer**: 50+ photos shared
- **Reviewer**: 25+ reviews written
- **Legend**: Achieve 10+ badges

### Implementation Phases
- Phase 1: Basic achievement system & badges
- Phase 2: Streak tracking
- Phase 3: Points & leveling
- Phase 4: Leaderboards
- Phase 5: Advanced challenges & rewards

### Rewards & Incentives
- Virtual rewards (badges, titles)
- Unlock special themes/customizations
- Bragging rights on profile
- Special badges for seasonal events
- Tier systems (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum)
